AUDIO COMMUNICATION NETWORK

📡 ACNET

A browser-based acoustic network and data-over-sound modem. ACNET moves text, files, messages, web responses, images, and low-resolution video through audio links using speakers, microphones, radios, telephones, or other sound interfaces.

4-FSK2-FSKGibberlinkClient / RelayOffline-capableSingle-file HTML

How it works

Client nodes send requests over sound. A Relay node can fetch online content and return it as acknowledged chunks. Duplex mode combines both roles where the audio setup supports it.

Reliable transport

Adjustable 2–100 sym/s operation, CRC validation, optional forward-error correction, chunk sequencing, ACK/NAK turnaround, retries, callsign support, and live signal diagnostics.

Built-in communication tools

🗂 ShowFileStore and transfer files through the relay.
📬 ACNET MailPeer-to-peer mail carried directly over sound.
🔐 Open.MailRelay-assisted private email for off-grid clients.
📮 public.mailClear-text public messaging without private credentials.
📺 SSTV PD290Transmit and decode 800×616 still images.
📹 HellschreiberExperimental low-resolution video over audio.
⚖ HAM ModePlain-text operating restrictions for amateur-radio use.
🌐 Acoustic browserRequest pages through a relay or browse normally online.

Quick start

  1. Select the intended speaker, microphone, and modulation settings.
  2. Start ACNET, then choose Client, Relay, or Duplex.
  3. Use chat, an ACNET app, or enter a URL such as https://www.example.com.
Experimental communications software. Link quality depends on audio hardware, levels, noise, echo, sample-rate behaviour, and the connected radio or telephone path. Operators remain responsible for lawful frequencies, power, bandwidth, identification, encryption, and transmitted content. HAM Mode is an operational aid, not a substitute for local regulations.
